6.description: [League 2] The Flamewaker Priests during the Sulfuron Harbinger encounter now have unique names to make it easier to distinguish them.
[League 2] Sulfuron Harbinger's Separation Anxiety now increases the effected targets total damage dealt by 100%. Before would only increase Physical damage.

[League 2] Re enabled Inspiration and Demoralising Shout on the Sulfuron Harbinger encounter. Demoralising Shout reduces nearby enemies Physical damage dealt. Inspiration increases nearby allies damage dealt.
[League 2] Shazzrah can no longer critical strike with melee attacks.

[League 2] Re enabled Shazzrah's Arcane Instability. Arcane Instability: Causes the target to explode after 8 seconds, destroying mana and inflicts arcane damage to the target and close allies. Targets that get hit by the explosion also get effected by Arcane Instability. Arcane Instability that got spread by an explosion will not apply another Arcane Instability.
[League 2] Shazzrah's Ultimate Arcane Explosion is no longer effected by cast time increasing effects.
[League 2] Shazzrah's Ultimate Arcane Explosion has its radius reduced to 18 from 30 yards.
[League 2] Shazzrah's Ultimate Arcane Explosion now deals a devastating amount of damage.
[League 2] Shazzrah's Big Arcane Explosion has been renamed to Ultimate Arcane Explosion.
[League 2]  Corrected an issue where Baron Geddon's Living Bomb would scale with a player's damage increasing and damage reducing effects.
[League 2] Corrected an issue where Baron Geddon's Inferno ability would not increase in damage correctly.
[League 2] Baron Geddon's melee attacks now deal Physical damage instead of fire.
[League 2] Curse of Gehennas now reduces all healing taken by 50% down from 75%.
[League 2] Gehennas Incinerate now roots the target in place instead of stunning it.
[League 2] Magmadar's Panic now lasts for 4 seconds down from 8.
[League 2] Lucifron's Curse can now be dispelled and increases ability costs by 50% down from 100%.
[League 2] Player under the effect of Lucifron's Gift now deal and take 50% less damage.
[League 2] Defeating Majordomo Executus now triggers a Checkpoint closer to Ragnaros Lair.
[League 2] Corrected an issue where Checkpoints inside Molten Core wouldn't activate.
